# Register map

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_regmap.py from scripts/regmap.yaml. Do not edit. -->

APB3 completer, 32-bit data, `PADDR[11:0]`, word-aligned. Access types: **RO** read-only (writes return `PSLVERR`=1 and change nothing), **RW** read/write, **W1C** write 1 to clear. Unlisted bits read 0. Any address not listed below returns `PSLVERR`=1 (ARM IHI 0024E §3.4) and changes nothing.

## Encodings

**mode**: RUN = 0, IDLE = 1, SLEEP = 2, DEEP_SLEEP = 3, SHUTDOWN = 4

**pd_state**: True = 0, CLK_GATED = 1, RET = 2, False = 3, FAULT = 7

**fault_step**: QACCEPT_DOWN = 1, QDENY_RELEASE = 2, PSW_MAIN_OFF = 3, PSW_TRICKLE_OFF = 4, PSW_TRICKLE_ON = 5, PSW_MAIN_ON = 6, QACCEPT_UP = 7

## Registers

### ID

`0x000`, RO, reset `0x504d5530`. Peripheral identification.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [31:0] | ID | `0x504d5530` | ASCII "PMU0". |

### VERSION

`0x004`, RO, reset `0x00010000`. Register-map version.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [31:16] | MAJOR | `0x1` | Incremented on incompatible map changes. |
| [15:0] | MINOR | `0x0` | Incremented on compatible additions. |

### MODE_REQ

`0x008`, RW, reset `0x00000000`. Requested system mode. A write starts a transition; the newest request is the target. Values 5-7 are not a mode: the write is ignored and PSLVERR=1. Hardware also writes this register on a wake event (WAKE_MODE is copied in). Reset value RUN: after PMU reset every domain is OFF, so the PMU powers them all up (boot).

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [2:0] | MODE | `0x0` | Target mode. (mode encoding) |

### MODE_STATUS

`0x00c`, RO, reset `0x00000004`. Current system status.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [10] | MISMATCH | `0x0` | Not busy, but some domain is not at the target of MODE_REQ (a deny left it in place). |
| [9] | FAULT | `0x0` | At least one domain is in FAULT. |
| [8] | BUSY | `0x0` | A transition is in progress (some domain is not at its target). |
| [2:0] | MODE | `0x4` | Last mode reached in full (every domain at its target). Reset: SHUTDOWN (all domains OFF). (mode encoding) |

### PD_STATE

`0x010`, RO, reset `0x00030303`. Per-domain state, 8 bits per domain d at bits [8d+7:8d]. Reset - every domain OFF.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [19] | PERI_BUSY | `0x0` | PD_PERI is in a sequence. |
| [18:16] | PERI_STATE | `0x3` | PD_PERI stable state. (pd_state encoding) |
| [12] | DSP_RET_VALID | `0x0` | PD_DSP retention flops hold saved state. |
| [11] | DSP_BUSY | `0x0` | PD_DSP is in a sequence. |
| [10:8] | DSP_STATE | `0x3` | PD_DSP stable state. (pd_state encoding) |
| [4] | CPU_RET_VALID | `0x0` | PD_CPU retention flops hold saved state. |
| [3] | CPU_BUSY | `0x0` | PD_CPU is in a sequence. |
| [2:0] | CPU_STATE | `0x3` | PD_CPU stable state. (pd_state encoding) |

### WAKE_MODE

`0x014`, RW, reset `0x00000000`. Mode entered on a wake event. Values 5-7 are ignored with PSLVERR=1.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [2:0] | MODE | `0x0` | Wake target mode. (mode encoding) |

### WAKE_MASK

`0x018`, RW, reset `0x000000ff`. Per-source wake mask. A source wakes the system only when its mask bit is 0.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [7:0] | MASK | `0xff` | 1 = wake_irq[i] ignored. Reset: all masked. |

### WAKE_TIMER_CMP

`0x01c`, RW, reset `0xffffffff`. Wake-timer compare value.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [31:0] | CMP | `0xffffffff` | A wake event fires when WAKE_TIMER reaches CMP while enabled. |

### WAKE_TIMER

`0x020`, RO, reset `0x00000000`. AON wake-timer count (PMU clock cycles since the timer was enabled).

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [31:0] | COUNT | `0x0` | Counts up while WAKE_CTRL.TIMER_EN=1; cleared when TIMER_EN is written 1. |

### WAKE_CTRL

`0x024`, RW, reset `0x00000000`. Wake-timer control.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [0] | TIMER_EN | `0x0` | Writing 1 clears WAKE_TIMER and starts it. Hardware clears this bit when the compare fires (one-shot). |

| [15:0] | CYCLES | `0x8` | 0 is treated as 1. |

### IRQ_STATUS

`0x080`, W1C, reset `0x00000000`. Interrupt status. A bit sets on its event; writing 1 clears it. irq = |(IRQ_STATUS & IRQ_EN).

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [3] | WAKE | `0x0` | A wake event (unmasked wake_irq or timer compare) occurred. |
| [2] | FAULT | `0x0` | A wait step timed out (details in FAULT_INFO). Clearing it releases FAULT domains to OFF. |
| [1] | DENY | `0x0` | A domain denied a quiescence request (Q_DENIED); it stayed in place. |
| [0] | DONE | `0x0` | A transition finished with every domain at its target. |

### IRQ_EN

`0x084`, RW, reset `0x00000004`. Interrupt enables, same bit layout as IRQ_STATUS.

| Bits | Field | Reset | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [3] | WAKE | `0x0` |  |
| [2] | FAULT | `0x1` |  |
| [1] | DENY | `0x0` |  |
| [0] | DONE | `0x0` |  |

`0x088`, RO, reset `0x00000000`. First fault since IRQ_STATUS.FAULT was last cleared.

|---|---|---|---|
| [31] | VALID | `0x0` | FAULT_INFO holds a fault. |
| [6:4] | STEP | `0x0` | The wait step that timed out. (fault_step encoding) |
| [1:0] | DOMAIN | `0x0` | Domain index (0 CPU |
